transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Okafor. Here are the critical updates from my review of our current emergency plan and facilities records this week. Room 204 is the high school's designated severe-weather shelter and must retain enough clear floor area for 30 people, so it cannot be converted into a culinary lab. Room 206 is the approved alternative for the lab, but its usable floor area limits the culinary lab to exactly 12 student seats — not the 16 seats listed in the current draft request. I confirmed both points against the current emergency plan and facilities records this week. The conversion request used an outdated room inventory, which is why it listed 16 seats and left Room 204 as an option. So we need to correct the request to reflect Room 206 as the only viable location and 12 student seats as the maximum capacity.
